scope: Implement structural admission for one complete AC1032 DWG-origin VisualStyle source capture; no serializer or output support claim

requirements: DWG source and exact AC1032 source version
nonempty typed style set and no raw DXF carriers

LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, ACIS, or native CAD semantic support
